sentences.text: On October 6, 2026, Tumblebrook Urgent Care documented shoulder pain after a fall, limited overhead reach, tenderness over the anterior shoulder, and that an MRI was recommended.
On October 20, 2026, Tumblebrook Imaging documented signal change in the supraspinatus tendon on shoulder MRI and recommended clinical correlation.
On November 3, 2026, Dr. Lysander Quibble documented pain with abduction of 6/10 and a plan of injection versus surgical consult, with the patient to decide.
On November 24, 2026, Tumblebrook Physical Therapy documented strength of 4/5 and pain of 5/10.
